docTitle: Baibuli aha Mukoroogyo · Baibuli omu Kuraza Kumwe
metaDesc: Kuratira obwiire bw'Endagaano ya Ira, amagara ga Yesu, n'orugyendo rwa Paulo aha mukoroogyo gw'amazima — Baibuli ekabaho omu myanya y'amazima.

s.title: Baibuli aha Mukoroogyo
s.verse: “Obu twabamanyisa eby'obushoboorozi bwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo n'okureebeka kwe, bikaba bitari bigano ebigunzirwe obwengye bw'abantu, kureka tukeereebera n'agaitu ekitiinwa kye ky'obukama.” (2 Petero 1:16)
s.purpose: Baibuli tikiri migani. N'ebyahandiikirwe by'abantu abaatambwire omu myanya y'amazima, obwiire n'amaziina by'amazima. Kuratira enzira ezo aha mukoroogyo, omu muringo gw'obwiire — kuta aha kanuuti, nari ohweze ▶ orabemu kimwe-kimwe.
s.ot_kick: ① Endagaano ya Ira — omu bwiire
s.ot_h: Kuruga aha kuhanga kuhitsya aha kugaruka Yerusalemu
s.ot_lead: Tikiri rugyendo rumwe kureka n'enzira y'ekitebyo ky'okujunwa kuruga aha kuhanga: okuhanga n'okugwa → omwegyemu na Babeli → okwetwa (Iburahimu) → ensi y'endagaano → Okuruga → ihamba → okusingura → obukama → okuheebwamu → okunyagwa → okugaruka.
s.je_kick: ② Endagaano Ensya — amagara ga Yesu
s.je_lead: Kuratira amagara ga Yesu nk'oku Engiri zirikugamba, omu muringo — kuruga aha kuzaarwa kwe omuri Beteleemu, okurabira aha kubatizibwa n'omurimo gwe omuri Galilaaya, okuraba omuri Samariya, kuhitsya aha musharaba, okuzooka n'okwambuka omuri Yerusalemu.
s.pa_kick: ③ Endagaano Ensya — orugyendo rwa Paulo
s.pa_h: Kuruga Antiokiya kuhitsya ahu ensi egarukira — Rooma
s.pa_lead: Kuruga aha Pentekoseti omuri Yerusalemu, oku amakuru marungi gaatimbire aheeru ya Buyudaaya — okurabira omuri Asia Ntoya na Bulaaya kuhitsya aha mutima gw'obukama bwa Rooma. Toora rumwe aha rugyendo rutaano (orwa 1·2·3 + orugyendo rw'okuza Rooma + enyima y'okurekurwa) okuratira ebyabaireho omu Byakozirwe Entumwa n'ebbaruha ezaahandiikirwe omu nzira.
s.foot: Enshuro · Emyanya nekuratira ebyahandiikirwe bya Baibuli n'okumanya emyanya ya Baibuli okumanyirwe (n'amaziina g'obunaku obu ahu garikuhwera). Enkiiko z'enyanja, emigyera n'ebiyaga bishushaniziibwe kuruga aha byahandiikirwe by'ensi ebihamu (Natural Earth), byorobiziibwe.

eden.name: Edeni (Okuhanga · Okugwa)
eden.note: Omu nsi eyaahangirwe erungi munonga, ekibi nikitaaha kandi kicwamu okukwatangana ahagati ya Ruhanga n'abantu.
events: Okuhanga omu nnaku mukaaga — “biri birungi munonga”
Omuntu yaahangwa omu kishushani kya Ruhanga
Endagaano y'amakuru marungi ey'okubanza — “Orwo ruzaaro rukuhondahonde omutwe”

noah.name: Ararati (Omwegyemu)
noah.today: Orushozi Ararati, Bugwejuba bwa Turukiya eri izooba
noah.note: Ruhanga naacwera orubanja ensi eijwiire ekibi, kwonka naarinda amagara ahabw'omuryango gumwe.

babel.name: Omunaara gwa Babeli
babel.note: Ahabw'okwehimba okwenda kuhika omu iguru, Ruhanga naashaashaanya orurimi rwabo n'amahanga omu nsi yoona.
events: Amahanga nigashaashaana omu nsi yoona (Shinaari — enyima Babulooni)

ur.name: Uri
ur.note: Ekitebyo ky'okujunwa ekya Baibuli nikitandika n'okwetwa kw'omuntu omwe.
events: Ruhanga naayeta Aburamu kuruga Uri wa Abakaludaaya
“Ndyakwihamu eihanga rihango… enganda zoona ez'omu nsi nimwo ziriheerwa emigisha”

haran.name: Harani
haran.note: Omu nzira, naahikiriza okwetwa okuza omu nsi y'endagaano.

shechem.name: Sekemu · Kanaani
shechem.note: Omu nsi y'endagaano omuryango niguhangwa kandi endagaano neegyenda omu mazaaro.
events: Okutaaha Kanaani, ekyoto ky'okubanza — “Egi nsi niyo ndiha baijukuru baawe”
Abaana ba Yakobo ikumi na babiri — omuzi gw'emiryango ikumi na ibiri

egypt.name: Misiri (Gosheni)
egypt.today: Delta ya Nairu, Misiri eri izooba
egypt.note: Omuryango niguhinduka eihanga rihango — haza eihanga ry'abahuuku.
events: Omuryango gwa Yakobo gwona niguserengyeta kwiruka enjara
Eihanga rya Isiraeli erikukura nirihinduka bahuuku

sinai.name: Orushozi Sinai
sinai.note: Okujuna okukuru okw'Endagaano ya Ira — abahuuku nibahinduka abantu ba Ruhanga.
events: Ebibonyo ikumi n'omwana gw'entaama gwa Pasika

kadesh.name: Kadeshi (ihamba)
kadesh.note: Okutaikiriza kukafeza oruzaaro rumwe ensi — kwonka Ruhanga naaguma nabo.
events: Abakengyezi ikumi na babiri — kwonka abantu nibagaana kwesiga
Emyaka 38 omu ihamba — maana, ekicu n'omuriro
Aha rushaanga rwa Mowaabu, orushonborooza rwa Musa orw'omuheru (Ebiragiro)

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Aha muheru nibataaha baatunga ensi y'endagaano.

shiloh.name: Shilo (Abaramuzi)
shiloh.note: Bataine mugabe, buri muntu naayekorera eki arikwenda — omugabe w'amazima naayetengwa.
events: Ruuti — okwesigwa omu biro by'omwirima, omu ruzaaro rwa Daudi

jerusalem.name: Yerusalemu · Obukama Bwemwe
jerusalem.note: Obwiire burungi bwa Isiraeli — n'endagaano y'omugabe otahwaho.
events: Saulo omugabe w'okubanza, haza Daudi na Goliyaati
Endagaano na Daudi — “ekitebe kyawe ebiro byona” (2 Samueli 7)

samaria.name: Samariya · Obukama Obwaheebwemu
samaria.note: Obukama nibuheebwamu bwaasiisikara, obwo abarangi nibateera enduuru.
events: Ahanyima ya Solomooni, okuheebwamu omuri Yuda na Isiraeli
Eliya, Isaaya, Yeremiya nibateera enduuru bati ‘mugaruke’ — kandi nibaranga Masiya

nineveh.name: Nineve (Ashuru)
nineveh.note: Baagaya buri kuhanangirizibwa, amwena nigagwa okubanza.
events: Obukama bw'amwena nibugwa ahari Ashuru (722 EBC)

babylon.name: Babulooni
babylon.note: Ekiro ky'omwirima munonga — kwonka endagaano y'okugarurwa neeguma.
events: Daniyeli na Ezekieli — okwikiriza n'okworekwa omu kunyagwa

susa.name: Shushani (Perusiya)
susa.note: N'aha mutima gw'obukama bw'abapagani, Ruhanga naarinda abantu be.
events: Esiteeri naajuna Abayudaaya kuruga omu kuzikirizibwa
Nehemiya naashaba omu maisho g'omugabe kandi naatumwa

return.name: Okugaruka Yerusalemu
return.note: Nibagaruka baayombeka bunya — kwonka tihariho mugabe owaaijire. Nibategyereza Masiya.
events: Emibatsyo eshatu y'okugaruka ahabw'eiteeka rya Koresi (Zerubabeli 538 · Ezera 458 · Nehemiya 444)
Ekereziya kyaayombekwa buhya n'ebicwezo bya Yerusalemu byaagarurwa
Malaki — Endagaano ya Ira neecwa: “Reeba, nintuma entumwa yangye”

bethlehem.name: Beteleemu
bethlehem.note: Masiya owaaragaaniisibwe naaija omu rurembo rwa Daudi — Kigambo owaaba omuntu.
events: Naazaarwa omuri Beteleemu, orurembo rwa Daudi

nazareth.name: Nazareti
nazareth.note: Ruhanga naakura nk'omuntu omu rurembo rwa buriijo.
events: Aine emyaka ikumi n'ebiri, naabuuza n'okugarukamu omu ekereziya
Enyima yaagaanwa omu sinagoogi y'omu rurembo rwe

jordan.name: Omugyera Yorodaani
jordan.note: Omurimo gwe gwa bonene nigutandika — eiguru nirimuhamya nk'Omwana.
events: Mutima naaserengyeta nk'enjiibwa — “Ogu n'Omwana wangye ou nkunda”
Naasingura okwohibwa kwa Sitaani okushatu omu ihamba

cana.name: Kaana
cana.note: Omu kamanyiso ke ak'okubanza naayoreka ekitiinwa kye.
events: Amaizi gaahinduka viinyo — akamanyiso ke ak'okubanza

sychar.name: Sukaari (Samariya)
sychar.note: Enzira y'omurimo ogw'okubanza — okurabira Yerusalemu kuza omuri Samariya enyansirwe.

capernaum.name: Kaperinaumu
capernaum.today: aha rubaju rw'eiyaga rya Galilaaya eri izooba
capernaum.note: Ekitebe ky'omurimo gwa Galilaaya — okweta, okwegyesa n'okuhakanisibwa byona nibisangaanira hanu.
events: Naayeta abajubi yaayeta ekitebe kye hanu
Orushonborooza rw'aha rushozi — “Baine omugisha abakyene omu mutima”

galilee.name: Eiyaga rya Galilaaya
galilee.note: N'obushoboorozi aha butonde naayoreka ou ari.
events: Naariisa abantu 5,000 n'emigaati etaano n'enfi ibiri

caesarea_p.name: Kaisariya Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Abeegi nibetegyereza ku ari Kristo, kandi enzira y'omusharaba neekingurwa.
events: Okwatula kwa Petero — “Ori Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga ohuriire”

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Aha nzira erikwambuka Yerusalemu, naasherura ekyabuzire.

bethany.name: Betaniya
bethany.note: Naayoreka obushoboorozi bwe aha rufu, esande ye ey'omuheru etakatandikire.
events: Naazoora Lazaaro omu ituuro — “Niinye kuzooka, niinye magara”

jerusalem.name: Yerusalemu
jerusalem.note: Aha muheru ah'amazima Baibuli yoona erikuziza — omusharaba, okuzooka, okwambuka.
events: Okutaaha okw'ekitiinwa; naahindura emeeza z'omu ekereziya bunya
Aha Kyokurya ky'Omuheru naanaaba abeegi ebigyere
Naazooka aha izooba rya kashatu, haza yaayambuka omu iguru

antioch.name: Antiokiya
antioch.note: Kanisa erikutuma, ahu omurimo gw'abanyamahanga gurikutandikira kandi gurikugarukira.
events: Omu kushaba Mutima naayawuramu Baranaba na Saulo
Ahatandikiro h'orugyendo orw'okubanza, orwa kabiri n'orwa kashatu

seleucia.name: Seleukiya
seleucia.note: Oruhamba rwa Antiokiya — baaza omu maato Kupuro.

salamis.name: Salami (Kupuro)
salamis.note: Ahemereero h'okubanza omuri Kupuro — okurangirira omu masinagoogi.

paphos.name: Pafo
paphos.note: Amaani nigoorekwa aha abarikuhakana amakuru marungi.

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Oruhamba omuri Pamufiliya — hanu Yohaana Mariko naagaruka enyima.

pantioch.name: Antiokiya ya Pisidiya
events: Orushonborooza ruraingwa rw'ekitebyo ky'okujunwa omu sinagoogi

iconium.name: Ikonia
iconium.note: Baingi nibeikiriza, kwonka okuhiganisibwa nikubahiga okugyendaho.

lystra.name: Lisitura
events: Baamubanda amabaare baamureka nk'ofiire, kwonka naimuka

derbe.name: Deribe
derbe.note: Abeegi baingi nibakorwa; nibagaruka omu nzira yaabo kugumya amakanisa.

troas.name: Trowa
troas.note: Ahahindukiro ahu amakuru marungi gaatandikira okuza Bulaaya.

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Kanisa y'okubanza omuri Bulaaya — amakuru marungi nigasingura n'omu nkomo.
events: Ennyimbo z'ekiro, omusisi gw'ensi, omuryango gw'omurinzi w'enkomo gwaajunwa

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Ekigambo nikisiisa orurembo kandi okuhakana nikwiira.

berea.name: Beroya
events: Buri izooba baacondooza Ebyahandiikirwe kureeba oku biri

corinth.name: Korinto
corinth.note: Naaguma omwaka n'ekicweka, naatandika kanisa omu rurembo rw'obubi.
events: Naakora ehema na Akwila na Purisila
“Otatiina… Nkwine kandi tihariho muntu weena oraakukore kubi”

ephesus.name: Efeso
ephesus.note: Omutima gw'orugyendo orwa kashatu — ekigambo nikitimba omuri Asia.
events: Okwegyesa buri izooba emyaka ebiri omu ishomero rya Turano
Demetrio omuhesi wa feeza naatandika oruyongo

miletus.name: Mileeto
events: “murinde obusyo bwona… eki yaayecunguriire n'eshagama ye wenka”
Abakuru nibarira, nibamanya ku batakamureeba bunya

caesarea.name: Kaisariya
caesarea.today: aha rubaju rw'enyanja rwa Isiraeli eri izooba
caesarea.note: Emyaka ebiri naayekingira amakuru marungi omu maisho g'abategyeki n'omugabe.
events: Emanja omu maisho g'abategyeki Felike na Festo
Okwekingira kwe omu maisho g'omugabe Agiripa

jerusalem.name: Yerusalemu
jerusalem.note: Baamukwatira omu ekereziya, enzira ye nk'omusibe neetandika.

myra.name: Mura
myra.note: Baahinduka baataaha eryaato ry'Alegizanderiya eririkuza Rooma.

fairhaven.name: Amaziba Marungi (Krete)
fairhaven.note: Okuhanangiriza kwa Paulo okwo bareke okugyenda omu maato tikwahurirwa.

crete.name: Krete
crete.note: Enyima y'okurekurwa, ekizinga ahu yaasiga Tito kutebeekanisa amakanisa.
events: Naasiga Tito kutoora abakuru omu buri rurembo

malta.name: Melita
malta.note: Okurabira omu muyaga n'okusheenya kw'eryaato, endagaano ya Ruhanga neeguma.
events: Omuyaga mukambwe gwaasheenya eryaato, kwonka boona 276 baajunwa

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Baahika Itaari baasangaanwa abaikiriza bagenzi baabo.

rome.name: Rooma
rome.book: Ebyakozirwe Entumwa 28 · Ebbaruha z'omu Nkomo · 2 Timoteeho
rome.note: Amakuru marungi aha muheru nigahika aha mutima gw'obukama — tikuri kuhwaho kureka n'okutandika.
events: Emyaka ebiri asibirwe omu nju, naarangirira obukama atatiina
Kuruga hanu naahandiika Ebbaruha z'omu Nkomo (Abeefeso·Abafilipi·Abakolosai·Filemooni)
Enyima yaasibwa bunya, naahandiika 2 Timoteeho yaayitwa ahabw'okwikiriza — “Ndwaine orugamba rurungi… empaka z'okwiruka nziherize”
